snippet.title: MEN BECAME EXTINCT. ONLY WOMEN REMAIN.⚜️Yuri ECLIPSE⚜️ | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
⚜️ Eclipse | Butch x Butch Yuri Visual Novel on Steam Demo NOW ⚜️

🎮 Play the FREE DEMO on Steam now and experience the first taste of this rich sapphic dystopia:
🔗 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3280020

💚 Kickstarter Eclipse:
🔗 https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/yuri-eclipse/yuri-x-manga-x-visual-noveleclipse

🧬 What is Eclipse?
A bold, choice-driven Yuri Visual Novel where Butch x Butch romance leads the charge.
Set in a post-apocalyptic world without men, Eclipse combines supernatural powers, Egyptian mythology, and political intrigue into an unforgettable queer narrative.

👩‍🚀 Play as Haesu, a member of elite force “Eclipse,” and uncover dark truths hidden beneath a utopia ruled entirely by women. Every decision you make shapes not only her fate, but the future of this UTOPIA. Can you face the truth—amid love, desire, and spilled blood?

🔑 Key Features:
💘 WLW, Butch x Butch romance
🧠 Deep branching narrative
🧨 Action, mystery, and sapphic angst
🎨 Stunning manga-style visuals
🔫 Time Attack decision feature
🧩 59+ Steam achievements

📌 Follow Eclipse:
Twitter (Global): https://x.com/m8nsun_global

© Team MoonSun. All Rights Reserved.

Content Warning: Contains mature themes including depictions of violence, blood, and religious imagery.
